name: CapCut Heavy Overlay Pre-render Workflow
use_when: CapCut or another NLE lags because a short edit contains many overlays, masks, effects, and duplicates.
Each clip can be designed separately before final transitions are built.
The main timeline needs to stay responsive for timing, transitions, sound, and QC.
avoid_when: The clip timing is still changing heavily and pre-rendered replacements would create churn.
The project needs all layers exposed in the top-level timeline for handoff.
The editor would lose necessary handles by overtrimming the isolated clip.

timeline_pattern.pattern: main_timeline_placeholder -> open_clip_subproject -> keep_full_length_or_handles -> add_overlays_masks_effects -> export_or_render -> replace_placeholder -> final_transition_pass
timeline_pattern.handle_rule: Keep the full source clip or enough handles in the subproject; trim only enough to isolate the clip safely.
timeline_pattern.main_timeline_rule: The main project should contain lighter rendered or nested clips so timing, transitions, and sound remain reviewable.
timeline_pattern.spacer_rule: When deleting temporary overlay layers after export, keep a black screen, placeholder, or spacer in the gap until the rendered replacement is aligned so the project duration does not shift.
timeline_pattern.replacement_rule: Replace the original clip only after the subproject result matches the intended duration and visual beat.

motion.rule: Design dense per-clip overlays before the transition pass, but postpone transition-specific shakes until adjacent clips are visible together.

keyframe_values.handle_buffer: Keep extra frames before and after the visible action when transitions or speed changes may still need room.
keyframe_values.duration_spacer: A temporary black spacer is acceptable only as a timing placeholder; remove or replace it before final export.
keyframe_values.review_range: Review the rendered replacement against at least one previous and one next clip before deleting or hiding the placeholder.

sound.rule: Keep final SFX and mix decisions in the main project unless the sound is permanently married to the pre-rendered visual.

captions.rule: Keep captions outside pre-rendered effect clips unless they are part of the designed visual layer.

color.rule: If the subproject bakes color or glow, check that the rendered clip still matches the main timeline before transitions are added.

implementation.ffmpeg: Pre-render dense effect segments as intermediates after timing lock, keep source metadata and handles, then replace the segment in the final assembly.
implementation.remotion: Render heavy per-clip compositions separately or memoize them, but keep final timing, captions, and SFX in the top-level composition.
implementation.blender: Use separate scenes or strips for heavy composites, render intermediates, and assemble final timing in the VSE.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Open each heavy clip as its own project, keep enough length, add overlays and polish, export or bring it back, then replace the original clip in the main project.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use nested sequences, Render and Replace, or After Effects pre-renders while keeping final captions, SFX, and transition timing in the main sequence.

common_mistakes: Overtrimming the subproject so transitions no longer have handles.
Deleting temporary overlay layers without preserving duration, causing the main timeline to shift.
Baking captions into a clip that later needs repositioning.
Replacing the main clip before checking duration and beat alignment.
Adding final mix decisions inside a pre-render where they cannot be balanced later.
Forgetting to keep the original source or placeholder for revisions.
qc: Does the pre-rendered clip match the intended source duration or replacement range?
Was any temporary spacer removed or replaced before final export?
Are enough handles preserved for transitions?
Do captions and final SFX remain editable in the main timeline?
Does the main timeline play smoothly enough for timing review?
Is the original source or placeholder retained for revisions?
